items.title: Data Sources and Data Collection Methods

source_refs.note: 'Data Sources and Data Collection Methods' under topic 6.2, as printed (PDF 78, printed 74).

blocks.text: Data can be collected from many sources. Common sources include surveys, interviews, forms, sensors, and online platforms (such as blogs, social websites, and others). Manual data collection involves human effort, whereas automatic data collection uses machines and software. Data can be collected in real time or stored over time. The method depends on the purpose of the analysis. Good data sources and accurate data collections improve analysis quality.
